data.description: A retriever's eyes can produce four different magical rays, each with a range of 100 feet. Each round, it can fire one ray as a free action. A particular ray is usable only once every 4 rounds. A retriever can fire an eye ray in the same round that it makes physical attacks; firing an eye ray does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The save DC for eye rays is %1. The eye ray effects are as follows; Fire, dealing 12d6 fire damage (Reflex DC %2 half); Cold, dealing 12d6 cold damage (Reflex DC %3 half); Electricity, dealing 12d6 electricity damage (Reflex DC %4 half); Petrification, turning the target permenantly to stone (Fortitude DC %5).
data.name: Eye Rays
